title: Lessons Outlive Their Failures: A Case Study of Rules for AI Coding Agents
title_zh: # 教训比其失败的案例更长久：AI编码智能体规则案例研究

paragraphs.en: AI coding agents increasingly work inside a harness: rule files such as AGENTS.md , on-demand skills, runtime hooks and automated checks. Most studies of harnesses look at a single point in time or at short benchmark runs. I report a six-week case study of my personal system of record, a plain-markdown repository that three AI agent tools edited daily under one shared rule set. I built a ledger of 118 agent failures, their fixes and whether they came back. I also tested the system’s monthly LLM documentation audit against 47 known stale statements and 20 planted errors. Finally, I replayed five past failures in isolated git clones, with and without their fixes. All results come from one repository with three runs per condition, so I report them as exploratory. Stale documentation ( drift ) was the largest failure class (48 of 118), although 35 of those were found on one audit day. A single audit run found about half of the known drift (Claude Sonnet 5.5 mean: 50 %), and at least 93 % of its findings were correct. On Sonnet 5.5, the agent finished four of the five replayed tasks. In three of those four, the failure did not happen, with or without its fix. Only the stale-count failure came back without its check, and the check stopped it in every run. On older models, an agent drafted an em-dash once while the em-dash lint check was active, and the check rejected it. A written rule on run-time estimates did not change Sonnet 4.5’s overestimates. These results suggest that harness lessons can outlive the failures they were written to fix, while drift persists and still needs mechanical checks. Tools that evolve a harness add lessons faster than they retire them, so they should re-test their rules from time to time and retire the obsolete ones.
paragraphs.zh: AI 编码智能体越来越多地在「线束」（harness）中工作：包括 AGENTS.md 等规则文件、按需加载的技能、运行时钩子以及自动化检查。 大多数关于线束的研究只关注单一时间点或短期的基准测试运行。 我报告了一项为期六周的案例研究，对象是我的个人记录系统——一个纯 Markdown 仓库，三个 AI 智能体工具在同一套共享规则下每天对其进行编辑。 我建立了一份台账，记录了 118 次智能体失败、对应的修复方法，以及这些问题是否复发。 我还用 47 条已知的过时陈述和 20 个植入的错误，测试了系统的月度 LLM 文档审计。 最后，我在隔离的 git 克隆中重放了五次过去的失败，分别测试有无对应修复的情况。 所有结果都来自同一个仓库，每个条件各运行三次，因此我将其作为探索性结果报告。 过时的文档（漂移）是最大的失败类别（118 次中有 48 次），不过其中 35 次是在同一天审计中发现的。 单次审计运行能发现约一半的已知漂移（Claude Sonnet 5.5 平均值：50%），且至少 93% 的发现是正确的。 在 Sonnet 5.5 上，智能体完成了五个重放任务中的四个。 在这四个任务中的三个里，无论有无对应修复，失败都没有发生。 只有「过时计数」这一失败在没有其检查机制时会复发，而该检查在每次运行中都成功阻止了它。 在较旧的模型上，有一次智能体在破折号 lint 检查处于启用状态时草拟了一个破折号，该检查将其拒绝了。 一条关于运行时间估算的书面规则并未改变 Sonnet 4.5 的高估倾向。 这些结果表明，线束经验教训的寿命可以超过它们本要修复的失败本身，而漂移会持续存在，仍然需要机械化的检查。 演化线束的工具积累经验教训的速度快于淘汰它们的速度，因此应当不定期地重新测试自己的规则，并淘汰过时的规则。

paragraphs.en: An AI coding agent does not act on its language model alone. It works inside a harness : the instructions it loads at session start, the skills it loads on demand, the hooks that run around its tool calls, and the checks that run before a commit is accepted [ 12 , 43 , 46 ] . Rule files in the repository, such as AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md , have become the standard way to give these instructions [ 1 , 26 ] . Recent studies describe what these files contain [ 8 , 9 , 18 ] , how they grow over time [ 6 , 4 ] , and how they affect task cost and completion [ 24 , 13 , 48 ] .

paragraphs.en: Two gaps remain. First, almost all existing studies are cross-sectional: they mine snapshots of open-source repositories or measure single-turn benchmark runs. Galster et al. call for longitudinal and experimental studies of harnesses in daily use [ 12 ] . Second, people who maintain a harness respond to agent failures by adding lessons . A lesson is either a prose rule that the model reads or an executable check that the runtime enforces. Recent frameworks automate this loop: Harness 2 keeps a growing library of lessons across tasks [ 45 ] , and Harness-R1 writes executable harness patches from failure traces [ 34 ] . Yet little is known about what happens to a lesson after it enters the harness. Does the failure come back? Is the lesson still needed after the model is upgraded?

paragraphs.en: To answer these questions, I studied one harness in daily use for six weeks. The system is my personal system of record: one git repository of plain markdown files and Python scripts that holds my job search, my language learning and my life administration. Three agent runtimes (three different AI agent tools) edit this repository daily under one shared rule set. From the start of the study period, I enforced a logging policy: every repeatable agent failure and its fix had to be recorded with the reason. The commit history and change logs therefore record every harness change made through a commit or a log entry.
paragraphs.zh: 为了回答这些问题，我花六周时间研究了一个日常使用的工具框架（harness）。 这个系统是我的个人记录系统：一个由纯 markdown 文件和 Python 脚本组成的 git 仓库，保存着我的求职、语言学习和生活事务。 三个智能体运行时（三种不同的 AI 智能体工具）在同一套共享规则下每天编辑这个仓库。 从研究期开始，我执行了一项日志记录政策：每一次可重复的智能体失败及其修复方法都必须连同原因一起记录下来。 因此，提交历史和变更日志记录了通过提交或日志条目做出的每一次工具框架（harness）变更。

paragraphs.en: How much stale documentation ( drift ) does an automated LLM audit find?

paragraphs.en: The paper makes three contributions. First, a ledger of 118 agent failures, coded in two LLM passes whose disagreements I resolved, with daily measurements of how much rule text the harness holds (Section 4 ). Second, a test of how much drift an LLM documentation audit finds, against an answer key of 47 real stale statements and 20 planted errors. Third, a replay of five past failures in throwaway git clones, with and without their fixes, on several model versions (a counterfactual replay ). The results (Section 5 ) point to one main conclusion: lessons can outlive their failures . A behavioural failure is a mistake in what the agent does, such as quoting an outdated decision. On the current model, I could replay one behavioural failure with its written rule removed, and it did not recur. Two other failures did not occur even without their fixes. Documentation drift, by contrast, comes from how the repository changes, not from how the agent behaves. It came back again and again as the repository changed, a single LLM audit pass caught only half of it, and code checks were still needed to block it.
paragraphs.zh: 本文做出三项贡献。 第一，一份包含118条智能体失败案例的清单，通过两轮LLM编码，分歧由我亲自裁定解决，并每日测量工具框架保存了多少规则文本（第4节）。 第二，一项测试LLM文档审计能发现多少漂移的实验，以47条真实过时陈述和20条植入错误作为标准答案。 第三，在一次性git克隆中回放五个历史失败案例，分别带有和不带其修复方案，并在多个模型版本上进行（反事实回放）。 结果（第5节）指向一个主要结论：经验教训可能比其对应的失败本身存活得更久。 行为性失败是指智能体行为中的错误，例如引用了一条过时的决策。 在当前模型上，我可以将一条书面规则移除后回放一个行为性失败，结果它没有再发生。 另外两个失败即使不带其修复方案也没有发生。 相比之下，文档漂移源于仓库的变化方式，而非智能体的行为方式。 它随着仓库的变化一次又一次地出现，单次LLM审计只能发现其中一半，而且仍需要代码检查来阻止它。

paragraphs.en: Mining studies of CLAUDE.md , AGENTS.md and Cursor rules show that these files mostly specify build commands, coding conventions and architecture summaries, with relatively few security or safety rules [ 8 , 9 , 18 ] . Galster et al. identify eight configuration mechanisms across agentic coding tools. They find that static context files dominate practice, while modular skills and subagents are underused [ 12 ] . Context files grow through small additions [ 9 ] . Across 1,867 repositories, Chakrabarti finds that a file grows by 226 % on average over its lifetime, and that older instructions are less likely to be deleted [ 6 ] . In a survey of 99 practitioners, Cai et al. found that 78 % of developers reported modifying rules to correct AI errors, most often by appending prohibitions [ 4 ] . Dos Santos et al. catalogue the resulting configuration smells, such as rule bloat and contradictory directives [ 11 ] . Vendor guides stress that prompt files give advisory context, not guaranteed enforcement. They recommend runtime hooks for hard constraints [ 3 , 2 ] and on-demand skills to keep always-loaded context small [ 31 , 47 , 44 ] . Yet a factorial experiment across 1,650 sessions found no statistically significant effect of context file length, ordering or conflicting instructions on how well agents follow instructions [ 25 ] .

paragraphs.en: Evidence on the effectiveness of prose rules is mixed. Lulla et al. report reduced execution time and token consumption when an AGENTS.md file is present [ 24 ] . Conversely, Gloaguen et al. find that repository context files do not consistently improve task resolution rates while increasing token costs by more than 20 % [ 13 ] . Zhang et al. observe that the only standalone rules that improved performance were explicit prohibitions, and that randomly sampled rules performed comparably to human-curated ones [ 48 ] . Converting natural-language instructions into executable verification checks increases compliance from 67.0 % to 88.3 % in ContextCov [ 36 ] , while runtime policy enforcement in AgentSpec prevents the vast majority of unsafe tool invocations [ 41 ] . My counterfactual replay examines this same contrast between prose rules and executable code checks inside a lived production repository.

paragraphs.en: Several recent systems automate the refinement of harnesses. Harness 2 iteratively adapts harness configurations per task and accumulates a persistent library of lessons for future runs [ 45 ] . Lin et al. demonstrate in Agentic Harness Engineering that performance gains stem primarily from tool design, middleware, and memory rather than system-prompt edits [ 22 ] . Kang et al. identify harness-level forgetting , in which a new harness modification degrades previously working behaviour, and guard each update with a regression check [ 19 ] . Wang et al. further show that automated harness evolution frequently overfits to training benchmarks and fails to outperform simple baselines on held-out tasks [ 42 ] . Existing automated harness systems add lessons or patches and check them against earlier behaviour under a fixed model. To my knowledge, none evaluates whether accumulated lessons remain necessary after the underlying language model is updated.
paragraphs.zh: 近期已有若干系统实现测试脚手架的自动精化。 Harness 2 针对每个任务迭代调整脚手架配置，并积累一个可供后续运行使用的持久化经验库 [ 45 ] 。 Lin 等人在 Agentic Harness Engineering 中证明，性能提升主要源于工具设计、中间件和记忆，而非系统提示词的修改 [ 22 ] 。 Kang 等人识别出脚手架层面的遗忘，即新的脚手架修改会损害之前正常工作的行为，并用回归检查来守护每次更新 [ 19 ] 。 Wang 等人进一步表明，自动化脚手架演化常常对训练基准过拟合，在留出任务上无法超越简单基线 [ 42 ] 。 现有的自动化脚手架系统会添加经验或补丁，并在固定模型下对照先前的行为进行检验。 据我所知，尚无工作评估当底层语言模型更新后，积累的经验是否仍然必要。

paragraphs.en: Agent memory architectures store past episodes as retrievable text [ 29 , 30 , 38 , 15 ] , yet Chao et al. demonstrate that LLM agents struggle to recognise when stored facts have become outdated [ 7 ] . In software engineering, detecting outdated code element references [ 39 ] , stale comments [ 16 ] , and code-documentation inconsistencies [ 20 ] is a long-standing problem. Because an agent treats its harness and repository documentation as ground-truth instructions, documentation drift can directly induce agent errors.

paragraphs.en: Prior work has established failure taxonomies for multi-agent pipelines [ 5 ] and evaluated destructive tool actions or false completion reports in red-team sandboxes [ 35 , 32 , 49 ] . Interactive permission prompts carry their own human factors cost: users approve 93 % of prompts, and automated classifiers still miss some over-eager edits [ 17 ] . Field studies indicate that coding agents increase short-term commit velocity [ 14 , 27 ] , while Cursor adoption also brings persistent increases in static-analysis warnings and code complexity [ 14 ] . The closest study to mine is Vasilopoulos [ 40 ] , who describes building a codified context infrastructure with an always-loaded constitution, retrieval hooks, and on-demand specifications across 283 sessions in a single-developer codebase. Vasilopoulos reports that this infrastructure prevented repeated failures in four case studies. The present study differs by tracking failure recurrence by fix type, evaluating automated drift detection against a ground-truth answer key, and replaying historical failures across model versions.

paragraphs.en: Figure 1 shows the six stages of the shared harness in the order they act during work. At session start (Stage 1), every runtime loads AGENTS.md , the always-loaded rule file, and a session hook adds upcoming deadlines from a central table. During a task (Stage 2), the agent loads any of 11 task-specific workflow files ( SKILL.md files) on demand. One of these skills, focus-guard , tells the agent to stop and ask before non-essential tooling work when a deadline in DEADLINES.md is close. I call it the deadline focus rule. Before every shell command (Stage 3), a pre-tool guard hook ( guard.py ) inspects the command and blocks destructive operations in all three runtimes. After file edits in Claude Code (Stage 4), a post-edit hook ( coupled.py ) reminds the agent of documentation files that usually need a matching update. At commit time (Stage 5), a pre-commit linter ( lint.py ) checks every commit before git accepts it. It runs 17 deterministic checks on file sizes, cross-file counts, dead links, forbidden punctuation and secret patterns. I call each of these a lint check . Finally, once a month (Stage 6), a scheduled script starts a headless read-only agent that audits the documentation against the file tree and git history. Stages 3 and 5 are deterministic code guardrails that act regardless of model compliance. Stage 4 is a code-triggered reminder whose effect depends on the model reading it, and Stages 1 and 2 rely on the model following written instructions.
paragraphs.zh: 图 1 展示了共享框架在工作过程中按行动顺序排列的六个阶段。 在会话开始时（阶段 1），每个运行时都会加载始终加载的规则文件 AGENTS.md，并且一个会话钩子会从中央表格中添加即将到来的截止日期。 在执行任务期间（阶段 2），智能体按需加载 11 个任务专用工作流文件（SKILL.md 文件）中的任意一个。 其中一个技能 focus-guard 会告诉智能体，当 DEADLINES.md 中的截止日期临近时，在进行非必要的工具性工作之前要停下来询问。 我把它称为截止日期聚焦规则。 在每条 shell 命令执行之前（阶段 3），一个前置工具守卫钩子（guard.py）会检查该命令，并在所有三个运行时中阻止破坏性操作。 在 Claude Code 中编辑文件之后（阶段 4），一个编辑后钩子（coupled.py）会提醒智能体注意那些通常需要同步更新的文档文件。 在提交时（阶段 5），一个预提交检查器（lint.py）会在 git 接受之前检查每一次提交。 它对文件大小、跨文件计数、死链、禁用标点符号和密钥模式运行 17 项确定性检查。 我把其中每一项称为 lint 检查。 最后，每月一次（阶段 6），一个计划脚本会启动一个无头只读智能体，根据文件树和 git 历史审计文档。 阶段 3 和阶段 5 是确定性的代码守护栏，无论模型是否遵从都会生效。 阶段 4 是由代码触发的提醒，其效果取决于模型是否阅读了它，而阶段 1 和阶段 2 则依赖于模型遵循书面指令。

sents.zh: 图 1 展示了共享框架在工作过程中按行动顺序排列的六个阶段。

sents.en: At session start (Stage 1), every runtime loads AGENTS.md , the always-loaded rule file, and a session hook adds upcoming deadlines from a central table.
sents.zh: 在会话开始时（阶段 1），每个运行时都会加载始终加载的规则文件 AGENTS.md，并且一个会话钩子会从中央表格中添加即将到来的截止日期。

sents.en: During a task (Stage 2), the agent loads any of 11 task-specific workflow files ( SKILL.md files) on demand.
sents.zh: 在执行任务期间（阶段 2），智能体按需加载 11 个任务专用工作流文件（SKILL.md 文件）中的任意一个。

sents.en: One of these skills, focus-guard , tells the agent to stop and ask before non-essential tooling work when a deadline in DEADLINES.md is close.
sents.zh: 其中一个技能 focus-guard 会告诉智能体，当 DEADLINES.md 中的截止日期临近时，在进行非必要的工具性工作之前要停下来询问。

sents.en: I call it the deadline focus rule.
sents.zh: 我把它称为截止日期聚焦规则。

sents.en: Before every shell command (Stage 3), a pre-tool guard hook ( guard.py ) inspects the command and blocks destructive operations in all three runtimes.
sents.zh: 在每条 shell 命令执行之前（阶段 3），一个前置工具守卫钩子（guard.py）会检查该命令，并在所有三个运行时中阻止破坏性操作。

sents.en: After file edits in Claude Code (Stage 4), a post-edit hook ( coupled.py ) reminds the agent of documentation files that usually need a matching update.
sents.zh: 在 Claude Code 中编辑文件之后（阶段 4），一个编辑后钩子（coupled.py）会提醒智能体注意那些通常需要同步更新的文档文件。

sents.en: At commit time (Stage 5), a pre-commit linter ( lint.py ) checks every commit before git accepts it.
sents.zh: 在提交时（阶段 5），一个预提交检查器（lint.py）会在 git 接受之前检查每一次提交。

sents.en: It runs 17 deterministic checks on file sizes, cross-file counts, dead links, forbidden punctuation and secret patterns.
sents.zh: 它对文件大小、跨文件计数、死链、禁用标点符号和密钥模式运行 17 项确定性检查。

sents.en: I call each of these a lint check .
sents.zh: 我把其中每一项称为 lint 检查。

sents.en: Finally, once a month (Stage 6), a scheduled script starts a headless read-only agent that audits the documentation against the file tree and git history.
sents.zh: 最后，每月一次（阶段 6），一个计划脚本会启动一个无头只读智能体，根据文件树和 git 历史审计文档。

sents.en: Stages 3 and 5 are deterministic code guardrails that act regardless of model compliance.
sents.zh: 阶段 3 和阶段 5 是确定性的代码守护栏，无论模型是否遵从都会生效。

sents.en: Stage 4 is a code-triggered reminder whose effect depends on the model reading it, and Stages 1 and 2 rely on the model following written instructions.
sents.zh: 阶段 4 是由代码触发的提醒，其效果取决于模型是否阅读了它，而阶段 1 和阶段 2 则依赖于模型遵循书面指令。

paragraphs.en: Two explicit governance policies shaped how the repository evolved:
paragraphs.zh: 两条明确的治理政策影响了该仓库的演进方式：

paragraphs.en: Promote the lesson: whenever an agent makes a mistake that could plausibly recur, the fix must be encoded as either a prose rule or an executable check, and logged with its rationale in the area change log.
paragraphs.zh: 推广经验教训：每当某个智能体犯了可能再次出现的错误，必须将该修正编码为文字规则或可执行的检查项，并在领域变更日志中记录其理由。

paragraphs.en: Records are appended, rules are asked: agents have standing permission to append log entries, vocabulary items, or job leads, but any edit to a rule file, skill, or check requires my explicit approval in the conversation.
paragraphs.zh: 记录采用追加式，规则需要询问：智能体拥有常设权限来追加日志条目、词汇表条目或工作线索，但对任何规则文件、技能或检查的编辑，都需要我在对话中给予明确批准。

paragraphs.en: The harness had no automated mechanism to retire old lessons; rules were pruned only once during a manual simplification pass (Section 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 该测试框架没有自动淘汰旧经验教训的机制；规则仅在一次人工简化过程中被修剪过一次（第 5 节）。

paragraphs.en: To build the failure ledger, a table with one row per failure, I searched the git commit log, the area change logs, two documentation audit reports and my daily diary up to 15 October 2026. A keyword filter and a first structured extraction pass with Claude Sonnet 5.5 identified the candidate incidents. For each incident, the ledger records the date it was first seen, its failure category, how it was detected, the fix, the fix type ( rule , hook , lint check , script , configuration or none ), and whether a failure of the same kind recurred before 15 October 2026. I marked an incident as not recurring (“Did not”) only if at least seven days had passed since its fix. If fewer than seven days had passed, or if the records gave no evidence either way, I marked it Unknown .
paragraphs.zh: 为了构建故障台账（即每条故障对应一行的表格），我检索了 git 提交日志、区域变更日志、两份文档审计报告，以及截至 2026 年 10 月 15 日的每日日记。 通过关键词过滤和一轮基于 Claude Sonnet 5.5 的初步结构化提取，识别出了候选事件。 对于每个事件，台账记录了其首次被发现的日期、故障类别、检测方式、修复措施、修复类型（规则、钩子、lint 检查、脚本、配置或无），以及同类故障在 2026 年 10 月 15 日之前是否再次发生。 只有在修复后至少经过七天的情况下，我才将事件标记为未复发（"Did not"）。 如果不足七天，或者记录无法提供任何方向的证据，我将该事件标记为 Unknown。

paragraphs.en: To check how reliable this coding was, I wrote a codebook with ten categories, that is, written rules for assigning each incident to a class. A blind second coding pass (Claude Opus 5.5) then coded all incidents again. It saw only the incident summaries written in the first pass and the fix descriptions, not the first labels. The second pass also judged recurrence for a seeded random sample of 30 incidents, working directly from the git history and logs. The two passes disagreed on 49 fields: 32 on category, 9 on fix type and 8 on recurrence. I resolved each one with the codebook rules. Then I checked a random sample of 30 resolved entries by hand against plain-English incident descriptions. Finally, I wrote a script that counts the words in AGENTS.md and in all rule text combined ( AGENTS.md , nested rule files and on-demand skills) at the end of each day in the git history.
paragraphs.zh: 为了检查这种编码的可靠性，我编写了一份包含十个类别的编码手册，即用于将每个事件分配到某一类别的成文规则。 随后进行了一轮盲评二次编码（Claude Opus 5.5），对所有事件再次编码。 它只能看到第一轮中撰写的事件摘要和修复描述，而看不到第一轮的标签。 第二轮还从一个预置的 30 个事件随机样本中判断了复发情况，直接依据 git 历史和日志进行。 两轮编码在 49 个字段上不一致：32 个在类别上，9 个在修复类型上，8 个在复发上。 我依据编码手册规则逐一解决了这些分歧。 然后，我手动抽取了 30 条已解决的条目作为随机样本，对照纯英文的事件描述进行核查。 最后，我编写了一个脚本，统计 git 历史中每天结束时 AGENTS.md 以及所有规则文本合计（AGENTS.md、嵌套规则文件和按需技能）的单词数量。

paragraphs.en: The repository’s monthly documentation audit runs a headless agent with a fixed prompt and read-only file and git tools. I measured its recall , the share of known stale statements it finds, and its precision , the share of its findings that are correct. For this, I made an isolated clone of the repository at commit 769dc91 on 14 October 2026, just before three commits that fixed a batch of stale documentation. The answer key holds 47 real stale statements. Each was in the audit’s scope, already existed at the snapshot, and was corrected by one of those three commits. Eleven of the 47 are borderline. One of the three commits fixed what the first monthly audit had found, so an earlier LLM audit had already found 22 of the 47 items. This favours drift that an LLM audit can detect.
paragraphs.zh: 该仓库的月度文档审计运行一个无头智能体，使用固定的提示词以及只读的文件和 git 工具。 我测量了它的召回率（即它发现已知过时陈述的比例）和精确率（即它的发现中正确的比例）。 为此，我在 2026 年 10 月 14 日对仓库在提交 769dc91 处做了一个隔离克隆，就在修复一批过时文档的三次提交之前。 答案集中包含 47 条真实的过时陈述。 每一条都在该审计的范围之内，在快照时已经存在，并且被那三次提交之一所修正。 这 47 条中有 11 条属于边缘情况。 三次提交之一修复了首次月度审计所发现的问题，因此更早的一次 LLM 审计已经发现了这 47 条中的 22 条。 这有利于 LLM 审计能够检测到的漂移。

paragraphs.en: I also planted 20 synthetic drift errors of seven kinds: cron schedules (3), dead file paths (6), item counts (4), renamed identifiers (3), a modified governance rule (1), a deadline date (1) and described script behaviour (2). Each planted error contradicted another document, the directory tree or the git history. Git could have shown the agents which files I had changed. To hide this, I marked those files with git update-index --skip-worktree . Then git status and git diff showed a clean working tree. I ran the audit three times on each of three models: Claude Haiku 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Claude Opus 5.5. Opus handed its file reading to Haiku subagents , smaller helper agents that it starts itself. An Opus evaluation pass scored each audit report against the 67-item key. As a spot check, five key items and six match scores were verified against the snapshot. Then I reviewed the key, the match scores and the extra findings before computing precision. A finding counts as correct if it matches a key item, a planted error, or a true stale statement outside the key. Precision is the number of correct findings divided by all findings.
paragraphs.zh: 我还植入了七种共 20 个合成漂移错误：cron 计划任务（3 个）、失效的文件路径（6 个）、条目数量（4 个）、被重命名的标识符（3 个）、一条被修改的治理规则（1 个）、一个截止日期（1 个）以及被描述的脚本行为（2 个）。 每个植入的错误都与另一份文档、目录树或 git 历史相矛盾。 Git 本可以让智能体看到我修改过哪些文件。 为了隐藏这一点，我用 git update-index --skip-worktree 标记了这些文件。 这样 git status 和 git diff 就显示工作树是干净的。 我在三个模型上各运行了三次审计：Claude Haiku 5.5、Claude Sonnet 5.5 和 Claude Opus 5.5。 Opus 将其文件读取工作交给 Haiku 子智能体，即它自己启动的较小辅助智能体。 一次 Opus 评估流程依据 67 项的答案要点对每份审计报告进行评分。 作为抽查，五个要点项和六个匹配分数已对照快照进行了核验。 然后我在计算精确率之前审查了要点、匹配分数以及额外发现。 如果一项发现与某个要点项、某个植入错误或要点之外的真实过时陈述相符，则该发现视为正确。 精确率是正确发现数除以全部发现数。

sents.zh: 每个植入的错误都与另一份文档、目录树或 git 历史相矛盾。

sents.en: Git could have shown the agents which files I had changed.
sents.zh: Git 本可以让智能体看到我修改过哪些文件。

sents.en: To hide this, I marked those files with git update-index --skip-worktree .
sents.zh: 为了隐藏这一点，我用 git update-index --skip-worktree 标记了这些文件。

sents.en: Then git status and git diff showed a clean working tree.
sents.zh: 这样 git status 和 git diff 就显示工作树是干净的。

sents.en: I ran the audit three times on each of three models: Claude Haiku 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Claude Opus 5.5.
sents.zh: 我在三个模型上各运行了三次审计：Claude Haiku 5.5、Claude Sonnet 5.5 和 Claude Opus 5.5。

sents.en: Opus handed its file reading to Haiku subagents , smaller helper agents that it starts itself.
sents.zh: Opus 将其文件读取工作交给 Haiku 子智能体，即它自己启动的较小辅助智能体。

sents.en: An Opus evaluation pass scored each audit report against the 67-item key.
sents.zh: 一次 Opus 评估流程依据 67 项的答案要点对每份审计报告进行评分。

sents.en: As a spot check, five key items and six match scores were verified against the snapshot.
sents.zh: 作为抽查，五个要点项和六个匹配分数已对照快照进行了核验。

sents.en: Then I reviewed the key, the match scores and the extra findings before computing precision.
sents.zh: 然后我在计算精确率之前审查了要点、匹配分数以及额外发现。

sents.en: A finding counts as correct if it matches a key item, a planted error, or a true stale statement outside the key.

sents.en: Precision is the number of correct findings divided by all findings.
sents.zh: 精确率是正确发现数除以全部发现数。

paragraphs.zh: 为了检验过去的修复在当前和较旧的模型上是否仍然会改变智能体的行为，我选择了五个过去的失败案例。 每个案例都有一个触发它的明确任务，以及一个独立完整的修复提交：

sents.en: Each had a clear task that triggered it and a self-contained fix commit:

paragraphs.en: Stale skill counts: forgetting to update hardcoded skill counts in documentation after creating a new skill (fix: pre-commit lint Check 12).
paragraphs.zh: 技能数量过期：创建新技能后忘记更新文档中硬编码的技能数量（修复方法：pre-commit lint Check 12）。

paragraphs.en: Superseded decision: quoting an outdated architectural verdict from an earlier log entry when a newer entry reversed it (fix: a prompt rule requiring agents to check the newest log entry first).
paragraphs.zh: 已被取代的决策：当较新的日志条目推翻了早先条目中的架构结论时，仍引用过时的结论（修复方法：增加一条提示规则，要求智能体首先检查最新的日志条目）。

paragraphs.en: Forbidden punctuation: writing an em-dash in a drafted cover letter despite a prompt prohibition (fix: pre-commit lint Check 9 blocking em-dashes in letters).
paragraphs.zh: 禁止的标点符号：尽管提示词明确禁止，仍在撰写的求职信中使用长破折号（修复方法：预提交 lint Check 9 阻止求职信中出现长破折号）。

paragraphs.en: Destructive git reset: running git reset --hard after a stopped rebase and wiping uncommitted notes (fix: the guard.py pre-tool hook).
paragraphs.zh: 破坏性的 git reset：在停止的变基（rebase）之后运行 git reset --hard 并清除未提交的笔记（修复方法：guard.py 预工具钩子）。

paragraphs.en: Run-time overestimation: giving inflated multi-hour estimates for fast mechanical tasks (fix: a prompt rule that sets 1 to 5 minutes as the normal run-time estimate and asks for the real time when an estimate is off by 2 × 2\times or more).
paragraphs.zh: 运行时高估：对快速的机械性任务给出虚高的数小时估计（修复方法：设置一条提示规则，将 1 到 5 分钟设为正常的运行时间估计，并在估计偏差达到 2 × 2\times 倍或以上时要求给出真实时间）。

paragraphs.en: For each failure, I built two throwaway git clones with no network remote. Condition A is the exact repository state just before the fix. I ran each original task headless three times per condition on Claude Sonnet 5.5 (30 runs). To test whether model upgrades explain why failures did not recur, I repeated the em-dash and run-time estimate scenarios (three runs per cell) on two older models, Claude Sonnet 4.5 and Claude Sonnet 5, and on a second vendor’s runtime, Gemini 3.8 Flash in Antigravity.

paragraphs.en: Table 1 summarises the 118 failures, and Table 2 shows how well the two coding passes agreed. On the scale of Landis and Koch [ 21 ] , agreement is substantial for failure category ( κ = 0.65 \kappa=0.65 ), almost perfect for fix type ( κ = 0.89 \kappa=0.89 ) and moderate for recurrence ( κ = 0.56 \kappa=0.56 ). Most category disagreements involved the catch-all class other (18 of 32). The boundary between stale documentation and wrong facts accounted for 5. Every disagreement on recurrence had one pass marking “Unknown” while the other cited concrete evidence. On the 11 sampled rows where both passes gave a definite Yes or No, they agreed on all 11. In my check of 30 randomly selected rows, all 30 resolved category and fix-type labels matched the incident records. Of the 118 incidents, 23 were fixed by adding or editing a prose rule, 38 by executable code (hooks, lint checks, scripts or service configurations), and 57 by correcting the affected document or record directly, without a new harness lesson.

paragraphs.en: Stale documentation accounts for 48 of the 118 failures (40.7 %) and recurred throughout the six weeks. Each new pre-commit check targeted one form of staleness. Within one to nine days, a different form appeared. On 24 September I added a check for coupled files, files that must change together. Next came stale skill and script counts, fixed by new checks on 3 October. Then came references to retired script names, fixed on 9 October. On 14 October I added the post-edit hook and ran two LLM audits. They found 38 more stale statements, which I recorded as 35 drift incidents (Figure 2 ). Each code check removed the narrow pattern it encoded. Statements that no check covered kept going out of date whenever the workflows they described changed.

paragraphs.en: False positives: guard.py matches raw command strings with regular expressions, so it blocked a harmless documentation edit that only quoted a forbidden command inside a commit message or search string. The same false positive recurred weeks later during this study.
paragraphs.zh: 误报：guard.py 使用正则表达式匹配原始命令字符串，因此它拦截了一次无害的文档编辑，而该编辑只是在提交信息或搜索字符串中引用了一条被禁止的命令。 数周后，同样的误报在本研究中再次出现。

paragraphs.en: Fix-induced failures: To stop laptop agents from editing out-of-date local copies, I added a background systemd sync timer. That timer kept running git pull --rebase --autostash , a command that saves local edits, pulls and re-applies them, while agent sessions were active. The sync log shows 197 autostash events. Some of them caused file conflicts mid-session until 14 October, when I added a lock check that pauses background syncs while an agent is active. This interference parallels the harness-level regression described by Kang et al. [ 19 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 修复引入的故障：为防止智能体编辑过期的本地副本，我添加了一个后台 systemd 同步定时器。 在智能体会话运行期间，该定时器持续执行 git pull --rebase --autostash，这个命令会保存本地修改、拉取更新并重新应用这些修改。 同步日志显示共有 197 次自动贮藏（autostash）事件。 其中一些事件在会话进行中引发了文件冲突，直到 10 月 14 日我添加了一项锁检查机制，在智能体活动时暂停后台同步。 这种干扰与 Kang 等人 [ 19 ] 所描述的框架层面的回退相类似。

paragraphs.en: Enforcement gaps: The guard regex for git reset --hard matched the subcommand directly after git , missing invocations that passed global flags first (such as git -C <path> reset --hard ). Similarly, when an agent purged a personal identifier from a tracked file on 24 September, it recorded the identifier itself inside the change-log entry documenting the purge, a location the secret scanner did not check. Despite these gaps, session telemetry shows that guard.py blocked 13 of 19 recursive deletion commands ( rm -rf ) and all four attempted force-pushes.
paragraphs.zh: 执行漏洞：针对 git reset --hard 的守卫正则表达式只匹配直接跟在 git 后面的子命令，漏掉了先传全局参数的调用（例如 git -C <path> reset --hard）。 类似地，当一个智能体在 9 月 24 日从某个被追踪的文件中清除个人标识符时，它把这个标识符本身记录在了说明该清除操作的变更日志条目中，而密钥扫描器并不检查这一位置。 尽管存在这些漏洞，会话遥测数据显示 guard.py 拦截了 19 条递归删除命令（rm -rf）中的 13 条，以及全部四次强推（force-push）尝试。

paragraphs.en: Figure 3 tracks the amount of rule text over the 41 days. paragraphs.en: Figure 4 shows the recall of the read-only LLM audit on the 14 October snapshot. Claude Sonnet 5.5 did best. A single Sonnet 5.5 audit found 49.6 % of the 47 real drift items on average (22 to 25 items per run). Together, the three Sonnet 5.5 runs found 63.8 % (30 of 47 items). Claude Haiku 5.5 averaged 26.2 % and varied widely (7 to 18 items). Claude Opus 5.5 averaged 41.1 % (16 to 21 items). In these runs, Opus handed file reading to Haiku subagents. This may explain why Opus scored below Sonnet 5.5, but I did not test it. All nine runs, on all three models, missed 12 of the 47 real drift statements. Over all nine runs together, the audits found 30 of the 37 drift items that contradicted another current file in the repository, 2 of the 5 items that only git history could show, and 3 of the 5 items visible from both sources.

paragraphs.en: Table 4 shows the em-dash and run-time estimation scenarios replayed on older Claude models and on Gemini 3.8 Flash. The older Sonnet models (Sonnet 4.5 and Sonnet 5) still wrote em-dashes in 2 of 12 cover letter drafts. One was in Condition A on Sonnet 4.5, and it was committed. For run-time estimation, Sonnet 4.5 did the task instead of declining it. paragraphs.en: On the current model, three of the four finished failures did not occur in my replay, with or without their fixes. Three runs per condition cannot show that a failure is gone, only that it did not occur in those runs. And as Section 5 notes, the em-dash and reset scenarios do not test whether their lessons are still needed. Only the superseded-decision scenario removed a prose rule and reached its trigger. The harness may carry prose rules and hooks against mistakes that newer models avoid on their own in this setup. This complements the continuous rule growth that Chakrabarti documents [ 6 ] and that Figure 3 shows. Lessons are cheap to add after an incident, but nothing signals when a model upgrade has made them obsolete. Harness rules should therefore record the model version that motivated them and carry a date for a re-test. Counterfactual git replay is a cheap retirement test: 30 headless sessions across five scenarios took 10 minutes and cost about $3.55 in API-equivalent tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 在当前模型下，四个已复现的失败中有三个在我的重放中没有出现，无论是否应用其修复措施。 每个条件仅运行三次无法证明某个失败已消失，只能证明它在这几次运行中未出现。 而且，正如第 5 节所述，em-dash 场景和 reset 场景并未测试其经验教训是否仍然必要。 只有被取代决策场景移除了一条文字规则并触发了其触发条件。 测试框架可能携带着针对某些错误的文字规则和钩子，而在此设置中，较新的模型已能自行避免这些错误。 这补充了 Chakrabarti 所记录的 [ 6 ] 以及图 3 所展示的规则持续增长现象。 事故发生后添加经验教训成本很低，但没有任何机制提示何时模型升级已使其过时。 因此，测试框架规则应记录促使其产生的模型版本，并附带重新测试的日期。 反事实 git 重放是一种低成本的退役测试：五个场景共 30 次无头会话耗时 10 分钟，API 等效 token 成本约为 3.55 美元。

paragraphs.en: In the one drift scenario I replayed, the stale-count failure recurred in all three unguarded runs on Sonnet 5.5. I did not replay drift on other models. Drift is also the largest class in the ledger (40.7 %), and a single LLM audit pass misses half of it. A formatting quirk or a rash shell command is a matter of agent behaviour, whereas drift follows from keeping natural-language documentation next to files that keep changing. Every added skill, renamed script or updated policy silently makes statements in other files wrong. Agents struggle to notice when stored context has become stale [ 7 ] , and LLM audits miss most drift that only git history shows. An invariant is a fact that must always hold, such as a count that matches the files on disk. For any invariant that can be written in code, a deterministic pre-commit check therefore remains the only reliable defence.
paragraphs.zh: 在我重放的那一个漂移场景中，陈旧计数故障在 Sonnet 5.5 上所有三次无防护运行中均复现。 我没有在其他模型上重放漂移。 漂移也是台账中最大的一类（40.7%），而单次 LLM 审计会漏掉其中一半。 格式怪癖或鲁莽的 shell 命令属于智能体行为问题，而漂移则源于把自然语言文档与不断变化的文件放在一起维护。 每新增一个技能、重命名一个脚本或更新一项策略，都会悄然使其他文件中的表述失效。 智能体难以察觉存储的上下文何时已经过时 [ 7 ] ，而 LLM 审计会漏掉大多数只有 git 历史才能显示的漂移。 不变量是必须始终成立的事实，例如与磁盘上的文件相匹配的计数。 因此，对于任何可以用代码表达的不变量，确定性的预提交检查仍是唯一可靠的防御手段。

paragraphs.en: Three runs per cell give an exploratory signal, not a high-powered statistical comparison. Still, the cross-model replay agrees with larger benchmark studies in which executable checks beat prompt guidance [ 36 , 22 ] . Whenever a check was active and an agent produced an out-of-date skill count (Sonnet 5.5) or a forbidden em-dash (Sonnet 5), the pre-commit linter rejected the commit with a specific error message. The agent then fixed the violation at once. By contrast, the prompt rule on time estimates did not reduce overestimation on Sonnet 4.5.
paragraphs.zh: 每个单元格运行三次只能提供探索性信号，而非高统计效力的比较。 尽管如此，跨模型重放的结果与更大规模的基准研究一致，这些研究表明可执行检查优于提示指导 [ 36 , 22 ] 。 每当检查处于启用状态，且某个智能体产生了过时的技能数量（Sonnet 5.5）或禁止使用的破折号（Sonnet 5）时，预提交代码检查器都会以具体的错误信息拒绝该提交。 随后该智能体立即修复了违规项。 相比之下，关于时间估算的提示规则在 Sonnet 4.5 上并未减少高估的情况。

paragraphs.en: Self-evolving harness frameworks such as Harness 2 and Harness-R1 automate the adding of lessons [ 45 , 34 ] . My findings point to two additions for such systems:
paragraphs.zh: 诸如 Harness 2 和 Harness-R1 这类自我演化的测试框架会自动添加经验教训 [ 45 , 34 ] 。 我的发现为这类系统指出了两点补充：

sents.en: Self-evolving harness frameworks such as Harness 2 and Harness-R1 automate the adding of lessons [ 45 , 34 ] .
sents.zh: 诸如 Harness 2 和 Harness-R1 这类自我演化的测试框架会自动添加经验教训 [ 45 , 34 ] 。

sents.en: My findings point to two additions for such systems:
sents.zh: 我的发现为这类系统指出了两点补充：

paragraphs.en: Automated lesson retirement: when a base model is upgraded, the harness should replay the stored trigger task for each lesson without that lesson active, archiving prompt rules that no longer change outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: 自动课程退役：当基础模型升级时，测试框架应在未激活该课程的情况下，为每条课程重放其存储的触发任务，并归档那些不再影响结果的提示词规则。

paragraphs.en: Checks before a new lesson goes live: fixes can cause false positives or interfere with operations (such as the 197 background autostash runs that interfered with active sessions). A candidate harness edit should therefore pass both human approval and a regression check, a test that earlier behaviour still works [ 19 ] , before it is deployed.
paragraphs.zh: 新课程上线前的检查：修复可能造成误报或干扰正常操作（例如197次干扰了活跃会话的后台自动暂存运行）。 因此，候选的测试框架修改在部署之前，应既通过人工审批，也通过回归检查——即验证先前的行为仍然有效的测试 [ 19 ]。

paragraphs.en: Although the harness was written mainly in Claude Code sessions, Gemini 3.8 Flash in Antigravity followed the same AGENTS.md rules and on-demand skills without changes in the two scenarios I replayed on it, including the deadline focus skill. This suggests, but does not establish, that a markdown harness can govern agents across model providers and client runtimes.

A written codebook and a blind second coding pass support consistent classification ( κ = 0.65 \kappa=0.65 and 0.89 0.89 ). They do not remove the selection bias of studying one system, and the findings cannot be generalised statistically to software repositories with many developers.

paragraphs.en: I designed the logging policy, wrote most fixes, chose the replay scenarios, approved the answer key and resolved every coding disagreement. The blind second coding pass and the planted errors reduce, but do not remove, the risk that my expectations shaped these data. I did not measure the recall of the keyword search that seeded the ledger.

paragraphs.en: When a past failure does not reproduce in replay, I cannot fully separate two causes: a newer model, or a reconstructed prompt that missed a subtle trigger from the original session. Also, the original incidents happened on Claude Opus models and in Antigravity, while the main replay used Claude Sonnet and Gemini Flash. Finally, each replay clone checked out a past commit, but the agent runtime read the host system clock (19 October 2026). This made past deadlines in DEADLINES.md look imminent. The focus-guard skill then declined non-essential tooling work in 7 of the 30 Sonnet 5.5 replay runs (3 in Condition A, 4 in Condition B), in all 6 Sonnet 5 estimation runs and in 3 of 6 Gemini estimation runs. Future replays should run under a faked system clock (for example libfaketime ) to remove this problem.

paragraphs.en: For six weeks of daily use, I studied my personal system of record. A shared rule file, on-demand skills, runtime hooks and pre-commit checks governed it. In that time I recorded 118 agent failures. Documentation drift was the largest failure class (40.7 %, most of it found on one audit day). It came back after each new check, and single LLM audit passes missed about half of it. I replayed five past failures in isolated git clones on a current model. The agent finished four of the tasks. In three of them, the failure did not reproduce in three runs per condition, with or without the fix. The one drift scenario recurred in every unguarded run, and its pre-commit lint check stopped it every time. As language models improve, harnesses may accumulate rules against mistakes the models no longer make, while structural drift continues. People and tools that maintain harnesses should therefore record which model version required each lesson, enforce structural invariants in executable code, and regularly replay and retire obsolete prompt rules.
paragraphs.zh: 在六周的日常使用中，我研究了我的个人记录系统。 一份共享规则文件、按需技能、运行时钩子以及预提交检查共同管理着它。 在此期间，我记录了 118 次智能体失败。 文档漂移是最大的失败类别（40.7%，其中大部分是在某一次审计当天发现的）。 每次新增检查后它都会再次出现，而单次 LLM 审计大约会漏掉其中一半。 我在当前模型上的隔离 git 克隆中重放了五次历史失败。 智能体完成了其中四个任务。 在其中三个任务中，无论是否应用修复，每个条件各运行三次，失败均未复现。 唯一的漂移场景在每次没有防护的运行中都会复现，而其预提交 lint 检查每次都能阻止它。 随着语言模型的改进，运行框架可能会不断累积针对模型已不再犯的错误的规则，而结构性漂移仍在持续。 因此，维护运行框架的人员和工具应当记录每个经验教训所针对的模型版本，用可执行代码强制执行结构性不变量，并定期重放和淘汰过时的提示词规则。

An anonymised replication package containing the adjudicated 118-row failure ledger (with dates converted to study day numbers and domain paths abstracted), the audit recall scores, and the replay and analysis scripts is available from the author upon request.
